title: Backend Registry Entry (FR-016)
description: Schema for entries in plugins/manifest-delegate/config/backends.json (JSON, stdlib-parseable — SC-005). Adding a backend = adding one conforming entry (identity + readiness probe + invocation/prompting conventions); no code surface may switch on backend names. Argv templates are arrays (never shell strings); placeholders: {model}, {prompt}, {prompt_file}, {output_file}, {session_ref}, {transcript}. Dangerous bypass flags (--dangerously-*, approval-skipping/bypass modes) are unrepresentable: every argv token is screened by the safeArg pattern below, AND the dispatcher re-validates the loaded registry at runtime — a violating registry refuses to run (exit 2).

safeArg.description: Argv token screened for dangerous bypass flags; enforced here AND re-validated by the dispatcher at registry load (violation => refuse to run, exit 2)

resume.description: Argv template resuming {session_ref}; null => backend cannot resume: dispatcher discloses and re-sends context (FR-015)

model_args.description: Argv fragment carrying {model}; dropped atomically when the tier resolves to 'auto'

tier_source.description: model_tiers key consulted when deployed parallel_agent.yml is present; values not found there pass through verbatim

default_tier.description: Economical factory tier (FR-009): codex 'auto', claude 'sonnet', antigravity 'flash'

session_id_capture.description: How the resume id is extracted from run output. jsonl_event (codex --json): scan stdout JSONL for the named event and read the named field; the event is version-gated — its absence means session_ref stays null and resume unavailability is disclosed (FR-015), never an error

field.description: JSON pointer/field name for json_field; field within the event payload for jsonl_event (e.g. thread_id)

event.description: JSONL event type for jsonl_event (e.g. thread.started)

pattern.description: Regex with one capture group for output_scan

input.description: Prompt input transport + payload limits. Large prompts NEVER travel through argv: transports are stdin (payload piped, then EOF) or temp_file (0600 file inside the job dir, path substituted at {prompt_file}); argv is allowed only for prompts under max_payload_bytes. Oversize context is rejected with an error naming the specific limit — never silently truncated (spec edge case)

max_payload_bytes.description: Transport-level payload cap; exceeding it => explicit error naming this limit

max_context_bytes.description: Best-known model-context bound; null => only the transport cap is enforced. Exceeding it => explicit error naming this limit

auth_probe_cmd.description: Non-interactive, <=10s; exit 0 = authenticated. MUST NOT prompt (US2-AS3)

retired_check.description: Optional detector for present-but-superseded CLIs (edge case) that classifies the install as 'retired'. null on all shipped entries; either detector field may be used alone

max_retired_version.description: Installed version <= this classifies as retired

probe_pattern.description: Regex; probe output matching classifies as retired

reason.description: Human explanation used in the readiness row

read_only_args.description: Default posture (FR-008), enforceably read-only: codex --sandbox read-only; claude sandbox-enabled --settings + --permission-mode plan + --disallowedTools write-tool denylist (a denylist alone leaves Bash as a mutation path); agy --sandbox --mode plan (bare --sandbox does not select the read-only mode)

write_args.description: Opt-in via --write. MUST map to a mode that pre-authorizes only sandbox-scoped workspace edits, keeping the sandbox engaged (codex --sandbox workspace-write; claude sandbox-enabled --settings + --permission-mode acceptEdits, no --add-dir beyond the workspace; agy --sandbox --mode accept-edits — the sandbox is never dropped in write mode); approval-escalating actions (network, outside-workspace paths, force-push/deletes that trip the backend's approval boundary) remain DENIED by the CLI's non-interactive mode — the dispatcher never grants approvals on the user's behalf and never uses bypass flags

prompting_ref.description: Path (plugin-relative) to the per-backend prompting guidance loaded before composing the delegation prompt (FR-007)

services_key.description: services.yml services.<key>.enabled toggle honored by readiness/delegation (FR-009/FR-013; workspace disable outranks user enable)

transfer.description: Session-transfer support; null => transfer unsupported: dispatcher states so and offers context re-send (FR-015). Methods form a fixed capability vocabulary (currently app_server_import): a backend fitting an existing method is entry-only per FR-016; a wholly new transfer protocol is a deliberate dispatcher extension (new enum value + handler) outside FR-016's entry-only guarantee
